about: Frame-level annotations of the real serve_bread rollouts (third-person video). Frames are 60 fps video frames of the named file; the burned-in speed labels (x8 / x16) are NOT trusted (see real_vs_sim.md). Each rollout is calibrated with motions of fixed duration in the real code: wrap-up = open_gripper(blocking, 1.0 s) + go_home(3.0 s); go_initial = 2.5 s; left arm activation 6.0 s after the right. 'release' = first frame with the gripper visibly open / bread free; 'home' = first frame at the folded home pose; 'grasp' = fingers closed on the bread; 'lift' = bread clear of the table; 'move' = first motion from the ready (initial) pose. Annotated by stepping through every frame (A: website/static/videos/serve_bread.mp4; B*: website/static/videos/cross_condition_3.mp4, frame numbers are full_demo.mp4 frames = cross_condition_3 frame + 3956).

A.label: x8
A.notes: starts mid-reach (right arm already descending). Both arms set the bread down before opening: right croissant touches the plate at k66, left danish laid on the croissant at k96-97. Both grasp near the END of the bread (fingers over the outer ~30 % of its length). Peak lift above the table, from the plate (24.5 cm = 204 px) as scale: right croissant ~25 cm (k36), left danish ~20 cm (k64).

B1.label: x16
B1.notes: rulers only 2 frames long: speed factor 75-100 +- 50 %
